verdict.rationale: TrueLayer ships an official MCP server for Claude AI (truelayer-docs-17, probe-3) with at least a documented `create-truelayer-payment-link` tool (truelayer-docs-27), and its APIs separately support account/balance/transaction retrieval (truelayer-docs-5, truelayer-docs-28) and connection management with scoped client credentials and ECDSA-signed requests (truelayer-docs-12, truelayer-docs-21). However, the MCP surface itself is only shown to expose link-session creation, not balance/transaction retrieval or connection management as MCP tools. Missing for 10: explicit MCP tools/endpoints for balance/transaction retrieval and connection management, and documentation of MCP-specific scoped credentials rather than general API auth.
